harvestIndicators: 6 ft height at bloom for max biomass
notes: Crotalaria juncea, tropical legume. Heat-loving. Fixes 100 to 150 lb N per acre in 60 to 90 days. Suppresses root-knot nematode populations. Frost-killed in northern winters. Inoculate with cowpea-type Rhizobium. Sold by Hancock Seed, Green Cover Seed.
